About Lob
Lob is bringing the power of digital to direct mail. With its nationwide Print Delivery Network and end-to-end automated platform, businesses can build personalized, high-quality direct mail programs at scale. Named 2024 Mail Service Provider of the Year by the National Postal and Postman Best API of 2024, Lob is trusted by over 12,000 brands, including L’Occitane, Ro.co and Simplisafe. Ready to see it in action?Learn more at lob.com
